entries.description: Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, session-set-authoring-guide.md, and re-read spec.md
Surfaced Decisions 1 and 2 to human via AskUserQuestion. Captured: D1=(b) structured prose; D2=(a) generic-now (both spec defaults).
Authored inventory.md mapping 4 pilot workflows to harvester artifacts.
Authored _template.md with seven-section workflow-package template, both Open Decisions reflected.
Scaffolded AccessHarvester.CharacterizationTests project + 4 per-workflow folders; added to .sln.
Authored ai-assignment.md in-conversation per spec Cost Expectations.
dotnet build (0 errors) and dotnet test (all passing, 1 skipped Comprehension; 1 placeholder in CharacterizationTests).
Cross-provider session verification via Gemini Pro returned VERIFIED, 0 issues.
Re-read spec.md and Session 1 inventory/template materials for the Add an Order workflow before authoring the package.
Pulled Add-an-Order source evidence from the NorthwindDevEdition IR: frmOrderDetails, sfrmOrderLineItems, modValidation, modInventory, modOrders, related queries, tables, and enum definitions.
Authored packages/add-an-order.md using the Session 1 template and recorded confirmed business rules, source operationalization, generic component hints, and ambiguity log entries.

Added AddAnOrder characterization models and tests covering order defaults, customer tax-status defaulting, order save validation, line-item validation and uniqueness, allocation ordering/status filtering, and reallocation behavior.
dotnet build succeeded; dotnet test for AccessHarvester.CharacterizationTests passed (19 tests), and the full solution test run passed with only pre-existing warnings/skips elsewhere.

Cross-provider session verification was routed to Claude Opus per human direction instead of the spec's Gemini pin. Round 1 returned ISSUES_FOUND with 6 grounded findings; all were fixed and Round 2 returned VERIFIED.
Re-read project-guidance, lessons-learned, authoring-guide, spec.md, Session 2 deliverables (package + 4 test files), Session 2 verification rounds, and ai-assignment.

Independent semantic review of packages/add-an-order.md against source IR (modGlobal, modValidation, modInventory, frmOrderDetails, sfrmOrderLineItems, Tables/Orders, Tables/OrderDetails). Confirmed all Session 2 rules + confidence tags hold up; identified 3 gaps for falsification.

Independent review of 4 Session 2 characterization tests against source VBA. Anti-coupling check passed; falsifiability OK. Identified missing invariants: deletion-side reallocation (Form_AfterDelConfirm + Form_Delete) and explicit cross-order scope assertions for AllocateInventory.
Authored Session3DeletionReallocationTests.cs (5 tests) and Session3CrossOrderScopeTests.cs (3 tests) under tests/AccessHarvester.CharacterizationTests/AddAnOrder/.

Refined packages/add-an-order.md: new deletion-reallocation business rule (Section 3), 2 new invariants (Section 4), tightened section 5 step 9 cboProductCategories prose, 3 new ambiguity-log entries (Section 7).
dotnet build (clean, 4 pre-existing NU1903 warnings out of scope) and dotnet test sequentially. All 27 CharacterizationTests pass; full solution suite green.

Cross-provider session-verification routed to Gemini Pro per human session-local direction (overriding the router-config session-verification: gpt-5-4 default for one session). Verdict: VERIFIED, 0 issues.

Re-read project-guidance, lessons-learned, authoring-guide, spec.md, Session 1 inventory for update-an-order, the Add-an-Order package/tests, and the shared frmOrderDetails/order-status source evidence.

Authored packages/update-an-order.md covering the order lifecycle state machine: invoicing, shipping, payment, closure, delete eligibility, status-driven editability, operationalization, and open questions.

Added UpdateAnOrder workflow models plus transition/edit-policy characterization tests covering save validation, invoice/ship/pay/close transitions, delete eligibility and per-line reallocation, and the LockControls / SetFormStatus policy.
Ran dotnet build and dotnet test sequentially. Build succeeded; CharacterizationTests now pass 54 tests total; full solution suite passed with only pre-existing warnings and skips.

Cross-provider session verification routed to Claude Opus per human direction. Round 1 returned VERIFIED with 1 minor missing-coverage note; added the Paid lock-set test and Round 2 returned VERIFIED with 0 issues.

Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, session-set-authoring-guide.md (skipped - not changed), CLAUDE.md, ai-led-session-workflow.md, spec.md, and re-read inventory.md (Update a Product row), template, and Session 4 deliverables (packages/update-an-order.md + UpdateAnOrder tests) as the established single-pass pattern.

Pulled harvester evidence for Update a Product: frmProductDetail VBA + procedures, sfrmProductDetail_StockTake VBA, modInventory 12 functions, modPurchaseOrders (AddPurchaseOrderDetail, ReorderProduct), modGlobal enums (osNew/posNew/posApprove/posSubmitted/odsAllocated/odsNoStock/odsOnOrder), Tables/Products required fields + unique indexes on ProductCode and ProductName.
Appended Session 5 block to ai-assignment.md per session-local direction (in-conversation, no routed analysis). Recommended orchestrator: Claude Opus 4.7. Verification: Gemini Pro.

Authored packages/update-a-product.md following the seven-section template. Captures 17 confirmed business rules with evidence citations into frmProductDetail VBA, sfrmProductDetail_StockTake, modInventory (AllocateInventory, ProductReorderQuantity), modPurchaseOrders (AddPurchaseOrderDetail, ReorderProduct), modGlobal enums, and Tables/Products required-fields/unique-indexes.

Authored UpdateAProduct workflow models + 7 test files: ProductSaveValidationTests, ProductCodeFormattingTests, ProductDeletePolicyTests, ProductReorderPolicyTests, ProductReorderRoutingTests, ProductInventoryAllocationTests, ProductReorderQuantityTests. All anti-coupled: pure-function tests against UpdateProductWorkflow, no Forms/Recordset/MsgBox dependencies.

dotnet build: 0 errors, 286 pre-existing warnings. dotnet test: AccessHarvester.CharacterizationTests = 96 passed (7 new UpdateAProduct test files contributed 30 tests). Full solution = all projects pass; CharacterizationTests + Vba.Parser/Grammar/Resolver + Sql.Grammar + Pipeline + Integration + SymbolDb + Tests projects all green.

Cross-provider session verification via Gemini Pro returned VERIFIED, 0 issues. Verifier confirmed faithfulness, anti-coupling, confidence-tag conservatism, cascading-effect coverage, spec adherence, no missing invariants, and build/test fidelity. Cost: 0.030053 USD; tokens: 16306 in / 967 out.

Printed cost report (set total: 3.3691 USD across 5 sessions; Session 5 contributed 0.030053 USD via Gemini Pro). Updated ai-assignment.md with Session 5 actuals (VERIFIED, 0 issues) and Session 6 recommendation (Codex GPT-5.4 in-conversation; verification routes to Claude Opus by default for cross-provider against a Codex orchestrator).
